description: This file manages polling intervals for nodes, logs, and debug information within a UI application, providing functions to start and stop polling activities based on a host configuration object.

methods.name: export function startNodesPolling(host: PollingHost) { startNodesPolling
methods.description: Starts polling for nodes if not already polling, setting an interval to call loadNodes every 5 seconds.

methods.name: export function stopNodesPolling(host: PollingHost) { stopNodesPolling
methods.description: Stops polling for nodes by clearing the interval if polling was active.

methods.name: export function startLogsPolling(host: PollingHost) { startLogsPolling
methods.description: Starts polling for logs if not already polling, calling loadLogs every 2 seconds when the tab is 'logs'.

methods.name: export function stopLogsPolling(host: PollingHost) { stopLogsPolling
methods.description: Stops polling for logs by clearing the interval if polling was active.

methods.name: export function startDebugPolling(host: PollingHost) { startDebugPolling
methods.description: Starts polling for debug info if not already polling, calling loadDebug every 3 seconds when the tab is 'debug'.

methods.name: export function stopDebugPolling(host: PollingHost) { stopDebugPolling
methods.description: Stops polling for debug info by clearing the interval if polling was active.
